shapeVolume: All three horizontal planks and their modest seams remain legible at 192×352 logical use size; board fronts read as broad solid surfaces with calm blank centers.
Modest manufactured rounding and soft highlight rolloff make plank edges and post caps less harsh while preserving silhouette, panel height/thickness, post proportions and front-face area.
Two posts and four small navy fasteners keep their original visual role; do not copy the target enlarged square fasteners or inflated bevels.
color: Boards retain warm honey/golden orange, posts retain readable warm brown, and fasteners retain navy/dark blue.
The center of the board face stays clean enough for dynamic overlay content. Avoid orange clipping, pale washed-out edges, overly saturated glare, muddy brown bands or near-black lower post patches.
lightingHighlights: Wide soft tonal transitions visibly replace abrupt source facet bands; bright rims stay restrained and form-following.
Both left/right sides receive comparable treatment. Lower posts show warm form without becoming flat black, and the panel remains readable without directional ground shading.
Seams and attachment contacts may have shallow local occlusion, but no heavy black strip or luminous seam interrupts the blank front.
materialDetail: Material reads as softly finished cartoon wood from broad surface response; grain is optional and must remain low-contrast if used.
Fasteners stay distinct and dark with restrained soft highlights. Wood and hardware remain visibly different without glossy plastic glare.
Do not require the target painted grain, halo, exact texture pattern, or extra roundness.
artifactFreeReadability: Native S render has clean corners/contours and transparent edges on light, neutral gray and dark backgrounds at use size and enlarged.
No clipping, stair-step seams beyond normal rasterization, black dead spots, overlapping/coplanar noise, sudden normal breaks, detached hardware, outlines or halos.
In same-tile/repeated previews, the sign remains at the front edge, leaves the central co-occupant space usable, and preserves the foreground relationship without changing its registered scale.

rankedOutcomes.outcome: Give all three planks broad, softly graduated honey-gold volume, with calm blank front faces and a readable narrow seam; soften the hard banded faceted appearance without changing the native panel envelope.
Recover warm brown form along both posts through balanced ambient/overhead lighting; remove black lower dead spots while preserving enough value contrast to separate posts, boards and navy fasteners.

Use modest manufactured edge softness and clean transparent contours; retain exact hardware identity/positions and registered shared-tile placement without halos, directional cast ground shadows or surface artifacts.

reviewProtocol.comparison: Inspect original, fixed target and exact candidate at logical use size and enlarged, including light/gray/dark transparency backgrounds. No pixel identity or target texture matching is required.
requiredTechnicalEvidence: Hash verification for packet, project, native render and previews
Per-asset registered camera and frame/pixel aspect
Native mesh object identity/count and transforms/bounds against original
Root, footprint, sockets and shared-tile foreground metadata
Lighting symmetry and absence of ground-shadow catcher/raster substitution
reviewProtocol.verdictPolicy: Approve only visible improvement toward frozen criteria with no material defects and passing capture/asset contract. Missing evidence yields needs_evidence. At most three ranked blockers per round.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
